reviews.title: Beautiful home in an ideal location.
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for four weeks with my sister and her husband. My brother-in-law and I were both working most days and the house was big enough for us to each have our own work space while not hampering the fun of the non-workers. The house has incredible indoor/outdoor feel and the living space flows onto the pool deck. There is ample shade throughout the day and there are outdoor fans that keep the air under the overhang circulating well. The canal is easily accessible for swimming and paddling. We plan to return and might rent kayaks or bring inflatable ones.Leeward is close to everything and very safe. We have stayed in three different houses in Leeward and this is our favorite!

reviews.title: Architecturally best VRBO ever!
reviews.text: Amazing set up for 6 adults. Three en suites and a poolside half bath. Bedroom AC is perfect and with the help of a small fan kept the bathroom cool as well. It does get warm in the kitchen and living area but opening up early morning really helps. Had to close up at night for security. Beware of slippery poolside tile when wet. A crate of towels is provided and were essential to traversing the deck after rain or pool play. Kitchen is over the top stocked not just dishes and utensils but all modern appliances (including panini maker)! There is an amazing brand new Weber grill poolside which we loved using for steaks and local fish. Moonrise over the canal was spectacular. We made use of the paddle boards and snorkeled right off the dock. This is a truly wonderful house equally for chillaxing or adventuring. Was welcomed by Claire on our arrival with a very informative tour. Nice way to learn all the bells and whistles. Jacinthe, the property manager met our every need. Responsiveness and accommodation was top notch. On an island where daily necessities are exorbitantly expensive, there was enough paper towels, toilet paper, dish soap, laundry detergent etc for all six adults for 9 days - an unexpected luxury. One of our most perfect vacations happened right here. Highly recommend to all.

reviews.title: Fabulous, Well-Appointed Villa on the Canals
reviews.text: Our family of 5 (3 young adult children) stayed at the Villa and had a lovely time. The house is beautifully appointed with lots of amenities. Our daughter had the charming pool house all to her self and our two sons shared a bedroom. We had a comfortable and elegant master suite. The hot tub and pool added to the elevated ambiance along with the loungers, outdoor dining set and bar area. Being right on the canal, we took advantage of the house's paddle boards to see turtles when paddling around the canals. We also used the bikes to cruise around the Leeward settlement. The villa is an easy drive to many excellent restaurants and beautiful beaches. It is also is close to an IGA grocery store. But to be honest, everything is within an easy drive and once we got the hang of driving on the left with lots of roundabouts, we were fine. The house is also super close to the marina where the ferry to North and Middle Caicos, which was a trip highlight. We are also SCUBA divers, and the marina (a different one than the ferry), where we went out of on the dive boat was only 12 minutes away by car. Our two hosts, Jacinthe and Claire, were extremely attentive and helpful with the booking and check-in process. We felt very welcome - thank you for the welcome goody basket! Would love to come back.

reviews.title: Beautiful villa in a great location
reviews.text:
Beautifully located in the Leeward Settlement, this villa is spacious and bright, and includes all the amenities needed to enjoy the vacation. For us it was the perfect setting. In the morning we adults would enjoy paddle boarding along the canal while our teenagers would sleep in or enjoy the pool. The kitchen has everything needed so we could enjoy breakfast and lunch by the pool. In the afternoon we visited different beautiful beaches, all between 5 and 20 minutes drive. The location is very exclusive, yet close to restaurants, a supermarket and stores (10 minutes drive). 
The air conditioning in the bedrooms is perfect to refresh the rooms before nighttime and the several indoor and outdoor fans help with the heat during the day. The pool area is equipped with beach chairs, snorkeling gear and toys to use. 2 bikes are included and those were great to reach the Marina where there is a cafè that serves breakfast and lunch. We would definitely recommend Piccolo Ponte!

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We are a family of 5 with two girls and one boy so the rooms worked out perfectly! The house is beautiful and is on a beautiful canal with lots of turtles and fish swimming around. The pool was a lifesaver for us because we heard that the high temps and humidity were not the norm for this time of year. The humidity was almost unbearable if you aren’t used to it. The only downfall to the house was that it didn’t have air conditioning in the main rooms of the house, only in the bedrooms, so we tended to want to be in our separate rooms if we weren’t out and about or in the pool. Other than that one negative, the house is perfect! It’s very clean and plenty of necessities for cooking and such. I would definitely recommend this property but maybe in the winter months rather than the heat of the summer!

reviews.title: This Home Has Everything!
reviews.text: Our group consisted of 3 couples and we came up for both work and fun. This place really has it all. The pictures posted were accurate, but really, once you were on the property and in the house, it was even better. Jacinthe helped with everything from pre-stocking the kitchen to referral for places to eat, a private chef and mid week housekeeping. TCI can be a bit warm in the day (the mornings and evenings were very nice), but the fans in the common areas worked fairly well and the AC in the bedrooms were way beyond adequate. The kitchen was so well stocked with everything and anything you could need. I think even our private chef was somewhat impressed. The wifi was excellent. At any given time, six laptops and six cell phone were connected with no issues. The home itself is beautiful as is the surrounding landscape. The pool area was shaded in the the afternoon and very refreshing. There were bikes, SUPs, snorkel gear and plenty of pool and beach gear. The location was great too. We rented a car (recommended) and you could access Grace Bay area in less than ten minutes. There is a beautiful beach that you can walk to (maybe 10-15 minutes) that felt almost secluded (Pelican Beach). But if you want, a bike ride is less than 5 minutes or just drive with your group and park near the access trail in the same amount of time. The location seemed very safe and the house can lock up nicely at night. It has an alarm system and a safe, but we didn't feel the need to use either. Everything was self-sufficient and well cared for. Jacinthe and her assistant were extremely nice to work with. In short, this property is a perfect way to enjoy TCI and everything it has to offer.

reviews.title: Great Home and Hosts
reviews.text: The place was a great place to stay. The pool was nice and had to sun most of the day. The dock was nice to hang out at and swimming in the canal is encouraged. Each of the rooms had a comfortable mattress and sheets. The A/C in all the rooms worked great and the bathrooms were nice and worked out perfect (great long-time hot running water). We hired a chef one night and we highly recommend that. We also highly recommend the pre-stocking if you plan extended time at the villa (be specific as possible but they did a great job). Only downfalls were that there was no A/C in the common areas so really you spend most of your time outside or in your room, the fridge struggles to stay cold since it is a warmer climate and not A/C (suggest getting a lot of ice but beware it can melt in the freezer), and your obvious Caribbean bugs which is not the owners' fault as they took measures to eliminate bugs but just bring spray. We would reccomend to others.

reviews.title: Beautiful First Trip to TCI
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful trip to Villa Piccolo Ponte. The neighborhood was quiet, clean and safe and easy to access everything we needed (restaurants, groceries, trips from the local marina) with the bikes or our rental car. The canals in the backyard was great for standup paddle boarding and we saw a sea turtle most days while enjoying morning coffee.

The house itself was perfect. Good wifi, cold air conditioning in the bedrooms, calm beachy décor. It was also very private feeling due to the landscaping and property size even though there are neighbor villas on both sides. We cooked breakfast in the villa every day, packed lunches to bring to the beach, and went out for most dinners (reserve ahead!). We used the paddle boards every day. 

You come to TCI for the beaches (or maybe the bonefishing) and the location doesn't disappoint. Sunset beach is the closest and it is quiet and beautiful. You could walk (towards grace bay) for MILES...or just pack up the provided beach chairs and cooler and take the 5 min drive down to Grace Bay Beach (which we did twice in a week). 

Great value home for being on-the-water and in a higher-end neighborhood. Ticked all our boxes.

reviews.title: Family Friendly and Beautiful!
reviews.text:
From the moment we walked in we knew we had picked the right house and location. Everything was bright, beautiful and super clean. Although we loved having the pool, all five of us couldn't get enough of the SUP's. With the canal right there the kiddos (teenagers 14, 16, 18) were able to go up and down the canal as often as they wanted and saw several turtles each time. We even managed to go to the Mangroves on our own and do some exploring. If you do so I would recommend doing a guided kayak or paddle board tour first. Side note: We recommend the Clear Kayak tour. Best excursion of our stay! The guides are experts on the boat pass through that you need to cross to get the Mangroves and really explained how we needed to navigate the currents. Also we saw baby nurse sharks, turtles, a spotted ray, jelly fish, several species of birds and fed the Iguanas.
There is a beach about 3-5 min from the house called Pelican Beach, some of the best sunsets, beautiful water and super quiet. 
Our host, Jacinthe was amazing to work with. From before we even arrived to the end of our stay she was very prompt in answering any and all of our questions. I would highly recommend this place and if we are fortunate enough to go back to TCI in the future we would stay at Villa Piccolo Ponte again.
